youtube_description:
In this video, Gordon Ramsay joins Sean Evans on Hot Ones to eat a series of increasingly spicy chicken wings. Ramsay is known for his fiery temper, and he doesn't hold back when it comes to criticizing the wings. He calls some of them "diabolical," "atrocious," and even "the worst thing I've ever tasted."
